According to Stephen Zimmermann, General Counsel of Sygnum Bank, it’s an opportune time for Switzerland to “set clear, internationally aligned rules for stablecoins.”

He believes that allowing banks to issue stablecoins under their existing banking licenses would help strengthen legal certainty and reduce complexity.

Despite its support, the SBA recommended a comprehensive impact assessment to weigh the potential risks.
